title: ニュージーランドTの後に・疾風へ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr achieves a spectacular result, and I come away feeling that she's accomplished something significant today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As if to compete with Zephyr, Tokai Teio soon earns herself the status of "undefeated Satsuki Sho champion."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The news seems to energize Zephyr, so I suggest that her next race should be the Aoi Stakes—a 1,200-meter sprint.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After honing her speed at the Aoi Stakes, we'll aim for a G1 race! It's time to build some momentum.
